headline: US futures point to a mixed open as traders position for major bank earnings, housing data and this week’s CPI report
raw_text:
- S&P 500 Futures (@ES) edge lower by 0.02%, Dow Jones Futures (@YM) climb 0.55%, Nasdaq 100 Futures (@NQ) fall 0.58%, and Russell 2000 Futures (@ER2) gain 0.43% in early trading.
- JPMorgan (JPM), Citigroup (C), Wells Fargo (WFC), Goldman Sachs (GS), Johnson & Johnson (JNJ), and UnitedHealth (UNH) are scheduled to report Q3 earnings before the bell, kicking off the season.
- Oracle (ORCL) shares dip roughly 1% in pre-market trading.
- Today’s US data calendar includes NFIB Small Business Optimism at 6:00 AM ET and Existing Home Sales at 10:00 AM ET.
- Investors are focused on bank provisions for credit losses, net interest margins, and inflation commentary from management teams ahead of Wednesday’s CPI release.
- Japan’s Nikkei index (@NKD) fell over 1.8% overnight, while European equity markets traded mostly higher.
- Gold futures (@GC) edged up as oil (@CL) prices declined in overnight trading.
